response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT corpeventprx AS event_type, AVG(anlycount) AS avg_analyst_reports, AVG(inholdpct - instownpct) AS avg_ownership_difference FROM sentimentandfundamentals GROUP BY corpeventprx), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ownership_difference) AS avg_event_difference FROM event_averages) SELECT e.event_type, e.avg_analyst_reports, e.avg_ownership_difference, e.avg_ownership_difference - o.avg_event_difference AS difference_from_overall_average FROM event_averages e CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.avg_event_difference IS NOT NULL
